FDA-approved and produced under regulatory laws, Renalin aims to boost kidney function and maintain a healthy urinary system.
- [Romel Holdings](https://high6.com/project/romel-holdings/): A property firm in Baguio, Romel Holdings offers commercial and residential spaces such as Romel Mansion, Romel Suites and Romel Building, positioning itself as a one‑stop destination for offices, retail and residences.
- [Schetky](https://high6.com/project/schetky/): Schetky Bus &amp; Van Sales is a nationwide dealer of new and used buses and vans in the United States. Since 1942 the family-owned company has provided commercial and school buses, transport vans and electric vehicles with comprehensive customer support. It offers hassle-free nationwide delivery, parts and service, and is committed to helping clients find reliable, cost-effective transportation solutions tailored to their needs.
- [Cosmos Bazaar](https://high6.com/project/cosmos-bazaar/): Founded in 1926 in Binondo, Manila, this company evolved from a general-merchandise bazaar into the exclusive Philippine distributor of Pilot writing instruments and Nichiban Panfix adhesive tapes. It also supplies Japanese brands like Bigen hair dye and Kokuryu cosmetics.
- [Simplex](https://high6.com/project/simplex/): Simplex Industrial Corporation is the Philippines&#039; leading distributor of ISO 9001/9002 rubber sealing products. With eight branches nationwide, it offers oil seals, O-rings and gaskets. The mission is to supply complete sealing solutions and expert consultation; the vision is to expand top-quality products across industrial, automotive, manufacturing and construction markets.
- [Slenda](https://high6.com/project/slenda/): Slenda is a multi-herb weight loss supplement by Go Natural. It combines Resveratrol, Banaba, turmeric and green tea extracts to promote natural weight management, improved metabolism and antioxidant benefits. The FDA-approved, CGMP/ISO certified capsules deliver safe, natural slimming support without steroids or harsh chemicals, making it a trusted herbal option for weight control.
- [St. Stephen’s High School](https://high6.com/project/st-stephens-high-school/): St. Stephen&#039;s High School in Binondo, Manila, is an Episcopalian Chinese-Filipino school founded in 1917. Considered the first Christian Chinese school in Luzon, it offers education from pre-kindergarten to Grade 12. The institution emphasizes academic excellence, Christian values and bilingual education, and holds Level III accreditation from the Federation of Accrediting Agencies of the Philippines.
- [Tagaytay Clifton Resort](https://high6.com/project/tagaytay-clifton-resort/): Tagaytay Clifton Resort Suites is a 2.3-billion condotel development by CitiGlobal in Metro Tagaytay. The project offers resort-like living with condo-hotel units surrounded by open spaces and greenery, giving residents a relaxing oasis near Manila. It provides affordable units, attractive income opportunities, resort-inspired amenities and worry-free property management services.
- [Tagaytay Fontaine Villas](https://high6.com/project/tagaytay-fontaine-villas/): Tagaytay Fontaine Villas is a master-planned community across Monte Maria designed for middle-class Filipino families. Located in Metro Tagaytay, this exclusive 98-unit enclave offers serene living away from city bustle yet near modern amenities. The development features a cool climate, thoughtful amenities and family-friendly pricing, making it an appealing investment and bonding retreat.
- [AG Datacom](https://high6.com/project/ag-datacom/): AG Datacom began in 1997 developing call accounting systems and has grown into a leading provider of IT and telecommunications solutions. It offers business telecommunication systems, network security, structured cabling and call accounting software. AG Datacom designs tailored IT infrastructure and communication solutions for various industries and markets.
- [AgriPro](https://high6.com/project/agripro/): AgriPro Premier Nutrition, incorporated in November 2004, supplies specialty feed ingredients, feed additives and nutraceuticals for livestock, poultry, pets and aquaculture. Partnering with international manufacturers, AgriPro provides technical support and product innovations to help feedmill owners enhance animal health and performance through science-based nutrition.
- [Canon Tacloban](https://high6.com/project/canon-tacloban/): Canon Tacloban Inc. is an authorised retailer and service centre for Canon products in Tacloban City. It sells cameras, camcorders, lenses, copiers, printers, plotters and consumables, providing photography, printing, scanning and videography solutions for individuals and businesses. The company ensures product expertise, genuine supplies and after-sales support for customers.
- [Cravewell](https://high6.com/project/cravewell/): Cravewell Snacks produces guilt-free fruit and vegetable crisps using vacuum-fried technology. Its product range includes Mixed Veggie crisps made from okra, sweet potato and purple sweet potato; Banana Crisps from thinly sliced Homthong bananas; Purple Roots taro and purple sweet potato crisps; and Tropic Fruits blends of pineapple, banana, jackfruit, coconut and mango, offering healthier snacking options.
- [Founding Farmers](https://high6.com/project/founding-farmers/): Founding Farmers creates vegetable-based snacks that satisfy cravings without compromising health. Its vacuum-fried okra, sweet potatoes and other vegetables retain nutrients and are gluten-free, trans-fat-free and cholesterol-free. The start-up&#039;s mission is to provide guilt-free snacking and become Asia&#039;s preferred &#039;better-for-you&#039; snack brand.
- [Fourtify](https://high6.com/project/fourtify/): Fourtify Inc., owned and managed by Filipino women, curates healthy snacks and products for busy lifestyles. Through its Fourtify Market online platform, the company sources better-for-you foods and wellness items, supports local brands and encourages consumers to nourish themselves while pursuing modern work. Its marketplace fosters healthful living and community.
- [Hino Balintawak](https://high6.com/project/hino-balintawak/): Hino Balintawak, a division of Toyota Balintawak, Inc., became the exclusive Hino trucks and buses dealer in December 2008 and opened in March 2009. The Filipino-owned dealership offers Hino&#039;s 300, 500 and 700 series vehicles and aims to be the most trusted automotive dealer by providing world-class sales and after-sales service.
- [H-Star](https://high6.com/project/h-star/): H-Star Enterprises Inc., founded in 2001, manufactures, imports, wholesales and retails industrial stainless steel and related metals. Over 15 years it has expanded to aluminum, galvanized and black iron products. With a broad distributor network, H-Star delivers quality materials, fast delivery and competitive prices to construction and industrial clients.
- [Kawara](https://high6.com/project/kawara/): Kawara sources roofing solutions from around the world and is the exclusive Philippine distributor of clay roof tiles, asphalt shingles, stone-coated metal roofing, thatch and temple tiles. It also offers reflective thermal insulation and other building materials, providing durable and aesthetically pleasing options for various architectural styles.
- [KPP Powers](https://high6.com/project/kpp-powers/): KPP Powers Commodities Inc. imports and distributes raw materials, nutritional ingredients and feed additives for livestock. It promotes animal health and aims to become the Philippines&#039; leading distributor of veterinary medicines and feed additives by offering high-quality, competitively priced products, fostering partnerships and supporting sustainable livestock practices.
